cues: Chlorobenzene is a solvent for paints and rubber, and the starting point for phenol, aniline, dyes and drugs, and D D T. Para dichlorobenzene is the moth repellent in moth balls and toilet blocks.
Bromo and iodobenzene make Grignard reagents in the lab.
But chlorinated aromatics persist in soil and water, so their residues must never go down the sink.
